tool_args.rationale: All five pilot horizons are at or below 0.48, while the forecast target is 22.4. A long-horizon measurement can distinguish slow adaptation rates that fit the pilot similarly but predict different responses at the target.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short-horizon data mainly constrain the ratio of slow adaptation amplitude to time constant, not the two parameters separately.
It can produce a late reversal but omits the observed sink-gradient dependence.
Finer short-window sampling is less informative about slow adaptation than measuring at a long horizon.
